activity_summary: At Uxbridge a carter offered the straight road to Bishopsgate. You refused it and kept the long way, a mile out of the way, the same as you had come. You did not name what the straight road passes. You took water and no directions.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Chose the long way and stopped the conversation.

facets.activity: Kept the longer way at Uxbridge

topics: a mile out of the way

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I don't. The long way. The same as I came.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: A mile out of the way is the point.
